import sys
import math
import random

def read_ints():
    return map(int, input().split())

def read_int():
    return int(input())

def read_long():
    return int(input())

def read_string():
    return input()

def read_strings():
    return input().split()

def print_values(*args):
    print(*args)

def print_list(lst):
    print(' '.join(map(str, lst)))

def print_array(arr):
    print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))

def solve():
    n = read_int()
    K = read_int()
    d = read_ints()
    f = [[0 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(K):
        for j in range(K):
            f[10+d[i]-d[j]][10+d[i]-d[j]] += 1
    n //= 2
    g = [1]
    for D in range(17, -1, -1):
        g = convolute(g, g, 998244353)
        if n << (~D) < 0:
            g = mulnaive(g, f)
    print(n*10 < len(g) and g[n*10] or 0)

def clean(a):
    for i in range(len(a)-1, -1, -1):
        if a[i] != 0:
            if i == len(a)-1:
                return a
            return a[:i+1]
    return [0]

def mulnaive(a, b):
    c = [0 for _ in range(len(a)+len(b)-1)]
    big = 8*998244353*998244353
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(b)):
            c[i+j] += a[i]*b[j]
            if c[i+j] >= big:
                c[i+j] -= big
    for i in range(len(c)):
        c[i] %= 998244353
    return c

def convolute(a, b, mod=998244353):
    USE = 2
    m = max(2, math.ceil(math.log2(max(len(a), len(b)))-1))*2
    fs = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(USE)]
    for k in range(USE):
        P = [1053818881, 1051721729, 1045430273, 1012924417, 1007681537, 1004535809, 998244353, 985661441, 976224257, 975175681][k]
        g = [7, 6, 3, 5, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 17][k]
        fa = nttmb(a, m, False, P, g)
        fb = a == b and fa or nttmb(b, m, False, P, g)
        for i in range(m):
            fa[i] = fa[i]*fb[i]%P
        fs[k] = nttmb(fa, m, True, P, g)
    mods = [1053818881, 1051721729, 1045430273, 1012924417, 1007681537, 1004535809, 998244353, 985661441, 976224257, 975175681]
    gammas = garnerPrepare(mods)
    buf = [0 for _ in range(USE)]
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(USE):
            buf[j] = fs[j][i]
        res = garnerBatch(buf, mods, gammas)
        ret = 0
        for j in range(len(res)-1, -1, -1):
            ret = ret * mods[j] + res[j]
            ret %= mod
        fs[0][i] = ret
    return fs[0]

def convoluteSimply(a, b, mod, g):
    m = max(2, math.ceil(math.log2(max(len(a), len(b)))-1))*2
    fa = nttmb(a, m, False, 998244353, g)
    fb = a == b and fa or nttmb(b, m, False, 998244353, g)
    for i in range(m):
        fa[i] = fa[i]*fb[i]%998244353
    return nttmb(fa, m, True, 998244353, g)

def nttmb(src, n, inverse, P, g):
    dst = src[:]
    h = math.floor(math.log2(n))
    K = 1 << (h+1)
    M = K*K//P
    dw = inverse and pow(g, P-1-(P-1)//n, P) or pow(g, (P-1)//n, P)
    wws = [0 for _ in range(1 << (h-1))]
    w = 1
    for k in range(1 << (h-1)):
        wws[k] = w
        w = modh(w*dw, M, h*2, P)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(1 << i):
            for k in range(1 << (h-i-1)):
                s = j << (h-i)
                t = s | 1 << (h-i-1)
                u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2*P)*wws[k]
                dst[s] += dst[t]
                if dst[s] >= 2*P:
                    dst[s] -= 2*P
                Q = (u << 32)*invl(P, 1 << 32) >> 32
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P
    for i in range(n):
        if dst[i] >= P:
            dst[i] -= P
    for i in range(n):
        rev = (1 << h) - 1 - i
        if i < rev:
            dst[i], dst[rev] = dst[rev], dst[i]
    if inverse:
        in_ = invl(n, P)
        for i in range(n):
            dst[i] = modh(dst[i]*in_, M, h*2, P)
    return dst

def nttsb(src, n, inverse, P, g):
    dst = src[:]
    h = math.floor(math.log2(n))
    K = 1 << (h+1)
    M = K*K//P
    dw = inverse and pow(g, P-1-(P-1)//n, P) or pow(g, (P-1)//n, P)
    wws = [0 for _ in range(1 << (h-1))]
    ws = [0 for _ in range(1 << (h-1))]
    w = 1
    for k in range(1 << (h-1)):
        wws[k] = (w << 32) // P
        ws[k] = w
        w = modh(w*dw, M, h*2, P)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(1 << i):
            for k in range(1 << (h-i-1)):
                s = j << (h-i)
                t = s | 1 << (h-i-1)
                ndsts = dst[s] + dst[t]
                if ndsts >= 2*P:
                    ndsts -= 2*P
                T = dst[s] - dst[t] + 2*P
                Q = wws[k]*T >> 32
                dst[s] = ndsts
                dst[t] = ws[k]*T - Q*P & (1 << 32) - 1
    for i in range(n):
        if dst[i] >= P:
            dst[i] -= P
    for i in range(n):
        rev = (1 << h) - 1 - i
        if i < rev:
            dst[i], dst[rev] = dst[rev], dst[i]
    if inverse:
        in_ = invl(n, P)
        for i in range(n):
            dst[i] = modh(dst[i]*in_, M, h*2, P)
    return dst

def modh(a, M, h, mod):
    r = a - ((M*(a & (1 << 31)-1) >> 31) + (M*(a >> 31) >> h-31)*mod)
    return r < mod and r or r - mod

def garnerPrepare(m):
    n = len(m)
    gamma = [0 for _ in range(n)]
    for k in range(1, n):
        prod = 1
        for i in range(k):
            prod = prod * m[i] % m[k]
        gamma[k] = invl(prod, m[k])
    return gamma

def garnerBatch(u, m, gamma):
    n = len(u)
    v = [0 for _ in range(n)]
    v[0] = u[0]
    for k in range(1, n):
        temp = v[k-1]
        for j in range(k-2, -1, -1):
            temp = (temp * m[j] + v[j]) % m[k]
        v[k] = (u[k] - temp) * gamma[k] % m[k]
        if v[k] < 0:
            v[k] += m[k]
    return v

def pow(a, n, mod):
    a %= mod
    ret = 1
    x = 63 - (n & -n).bit_length()
    for _ in range(x):
        ret = ret * ret % mod
    if n & (1 << x):
        ret = ret * a % mod
    return ret

def invl(a, mod):
    b = mod
    p = 1
    q = 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        d = p
        p = q
        q = d - c * q
    return p < 0 and p + mod or p

def main():
    solve()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
